agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, November 10, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy from Lomita Station
b.
4th Quarter Employee Awards
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on October 28, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-53 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks and Recreation Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
September 2015 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Ord. No. 775 - An Ordinance of the City of Lomita, Code Amendment No. 2015-0, to amend Section 10-1.01 (County Building Code Adopted) to adopt by reference the current version of Title 25 of the Los Angeles County Code including new Chapter 68, expedited permitting for small residential rooftop solar energy system. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said Ordinance No. 775 be adopted.
Item #7j
k.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $2,755 to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. for the West Basin 7 Import Connection Upgrade Project.
ACTION: Accept the work performed by Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. authorize the City Clerk to file the attached NOC with the County Recorder's Office; and authorize the Public Works Director to sign the NOC and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $2,755 to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptance warranty bond.
Item #7k
l.
Consideration of an extension of a Tolling Agreement between the City and the Housing Authority of the County of Los Angeles (HACOLA) regarding potential claims relative to Water Utility Billing Charges
ACTION: Approve the extension of the Tolling Agreement until March 12, 2016 and authorize the City and attorney to execute it on behalf of the City.
Item #7l
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION REQUESTING CALTRANS PREPARE A FEASIBILITY STUDY REGARDING THE REMOVAL OF PARKING ON PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Res 2015-54 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita directing Caltrans to conduct a feasibility study for the elimination of all on-street parking along Pacific Coast Highway from the west City boundary to the east boundary on both the north and south side.
ACTION: That the City Council hold a public hearing soliciting feedback from the public regarding the elimination of parking on Pacific Coast Highway; and adopt a resolution requesting Caltrans prepare a feasibility study for the elimination of said parking.
Item #8
9.
PUBLIC HEARING - TO DISCUSS AUTHORIZATION TO APPLY FOR GRANT FUNDS FROM THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY REGIONAL PARK AND OPEN SPACE DISTRICT AND APPROVAL OF A YOUTH EMPLOYMENT PLAN FOR NEW PARK DEVELOPMENT AT 1845 WEST 260TH STREET AND VARIOUS UPGRADES AT LOMITA PARK AND HATHWAY PARK
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Res 2015-55 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving the application for grant funds from the Los Angeles County Regional Park and Open Space District for Fourth Supervisorial District Proposition A funding for new park development at 1845 West 260th Street and various upgrades at Lomita Park and Hathaway Park and approving the adoption of a Youth Employment Plan
ACTION: That the City Council conduct a public hearing and adopt a resolution approving the application for grant funds from the Los Angeles County Regional Park and Open Space District and the Youth Employment Plan for new park development at 1845 West 260th Street and various upgrades at Lomita Park and Hathaway Park.
Item #9
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
10.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION SETTING A DATE FOR A STREET IMPROVEMENT WORKSHOP
Presented by Interim City Manager Burrell
ACTION: That the City Council select one of the following dates for a street improvement workshop: December 9, 2015; January 13, 2016; January 27, 2016; February 10, 2016
Item #10
11.
PROP C FUNDING PROJECT IDENTIFICATION (NARBONNE AVENUE PAVEMENT REHABILITATION) FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-16
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
ACTION: To create a new Capital Improvement Project titled "Narbonne Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation - Pacific Coast Highway to north City limits" and authorize use of available Prop C funds for the project.
Item #11
12.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING DAYS
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
Ord. No. 776 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Code Amendment No. 2015-05 an amendment to Section 2-1.01 of the Lomita Municipal Code change the regular Council meeting days. (First Reading)
ACTION: City Attorney to read and introduce first reading of Ordinance amending Section 2-1.01 (Regular Council Meetings) of the Lomita Municipal Code changing the day of regular Council meetings from the 2nd and 4th Wednesdays of each month to the 1st and 3rd Tuesdays of each month and schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance on December 9, 2015.
Item #12
13.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn in Memory of Rene Dominguez
The regular meeting of the City Council scheduled for November 25, 2015 has been canceled. The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on December 9, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
